# Sidekik

> Sidekik is a free iOS and Android app for paraglider pilots. Track Hike&Fly and XC flights, join Peak Hunt club challenges, see Livewind on the map, and follow friends. It works with XContest, Garmin, Suunto, and IGC/GPX; it does not replace a flight instrument.

Sidekik is made by Sidekik GmbH (Austria). The basic app is free; extra features are available with Sidekik PLUS. Clubs can run Peak Hunt challenges, tasks and leaderboards. 2,500+ pilots and 200+ clubs use it. Store rating: 4.7 / 5 from 158 reviews.

## Pages

- [Home (German)](https://www.sidekik.cloud/): default marketing site
- [Home (English)](https://www.sidekik.cloud/en): English marketing site
- [Features](https://www.sidekik.cloud/features): tracking, Livewind, On Air, stats, club challenges
- [For clubs](https://www.sidekik.cloud/clubs): Peak Hunt, club championships, pricing
- [Peak Hunt rules](https://www.sidekik.cloud/challenges): scoring, bonus points, safety
- [PLUS](https://www.sidekik.cloud/subscription): paid features for pilots
- [Blog](https://www.sidekik.cloud/blog): guides and updates (German listing; English at /en/blog)
- [About](https://www.sidekik.cloud/about): mission and origin
